name: job-application-master
description: End-to-end job application pipeline. Scrapes jobs with Firecrawl into a Google Sheet, scores your resume against each JD (0-100), tailors a truthful resume for every job scoring 75+ and saves it to Google Drive, then finds recruiters and hiring managers, drafts cold emails with the tailored resume and your portfolio link, and logs LinkedIn connection-request messages to a Google Doc.
